items.name: MetadataCommand
items.summary: A builder for configuring `cargo metadata` invocation.

methods.name: cargo_command
methods.summary: Builds a command for `cargo metadata`.  This is the first part of the work of `exec`.

methods.name: cargo_path
methods.signature: fn cargo_path(&mut self, path: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> &mut MetadataCommand
methods.summary: Path to `cargo` executable.  If not set, this will use the the `$CARGO` environment variable, and if that is not set, will simply be `cargo`.

methods.name: current_dir
methods.signature: fn current_dir(&mut self, path: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> &mut MetadataCommand
methods.summary: Current directory of the `cargo metadata` process.

methods.name: env
methods.signature: fn env<K: Into<OsString>, V: Into<OsString>>(&mut self, key: K, val: V) -> &mut MetadataCommand
methods.summary: Arbitrary environment variables to set when running `cargo`.  These will be merged into the calling environment, overriding any which clash.

methods.name: env_remove
methods.signature: fn env_remove<K: Into<OsString>>(&mut self, key: K) -> &mut MetadataCommand
methods.summary: Arbitrary environment variables to remove when running `cargo`.  These will be merged into the calling environment, overriding any which clash.

methods.name: exec
methods.summary: Runs configured `cargo metadata` and returns parsed `Metadata`.

methods.name: features
methods.signature: fn features(&mut self, features: CargoOpt) -> &mut MetadataCommand
methods.summary: Which features to include.

methods.name: manifest_path
methods.signature: fn manifest_path(&mut self, path: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> &mut MetadataCommand
methods.summary: Path to `Cargo.toml`

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Creates a default `cargo metadata` command, which will look for `Cargo.toml` in the ancestors of the current directory.

methods.name: no_deps
methods.summary: Output information only about workspace members and don't fetch dependencies.

methods.name: other_options
methods.signature: fn other_options(&mut self, options: impl Into<Vec<String>>) -> &mut MetadataCommand
methods.summary: Arbitrary command line flags to pass to `cargo`.  These will be added to the end of the command line invocation.

methods.name: parse
methods.summary: Parses `cargo metadata` output.  `data` must have been produced by a command built with `cargo_command`.

methods.name: verbose
methods.signature: fn verbose(&mut self, verbose: bool) -> &mut MetadataCommand
methods.summary: Set whether to show stderr
